learnings.question: Which economist, writing in 1971, first observed that a wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: In 1971, Herbert Simon observed that in an information-rich world, the wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention, since information consumes the attention of those who receive it.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: What Arabic term, mentioned in Surah Al-Mu'minoon, refers to ill speech, gossip, and meaningless talk that believers are told to turn away from?
learnings.learning: Surah Al-Mu'minoon (23:1-3) teaches that successful believers are those who turn away from 'Lagw' — ill speech, drama, gossip, and meaningless conversation.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned information within just 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus showed in the 1880s that people forget about 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively work to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What is the name of the phenomenon, also called 'Digital Amnesia,' in which writing information down causes the brain to stop bothering to remember it?
learnings.learning: Cognitive offloading, also called the Google Effect or Digital Amnesia, describes how writing information down signals to the brain that it no longer needs to remember it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact visualizes a sprint's progress and shows how much work remains?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Burndown Chart is the artifact that visualizes a sprint's progress by showing the remaining work and whether the team is on schedule.

learnings.question: In Scrum, which role is primarily responsible for protecting the team from distractions and facilitating the overall Scrum process?
learnings.learning: The Scrum Master role is responsible for protecting the team from distractions, helping resolve issues, and facilitating the overall Scrum process.

learnings.question: Surah Adh-Dhariyat (51:56) declares that Allah created the jinn and mankind for which singular purpose?
learnings.learning: Surah Adh-Dhariyat (51:56) states that Allah created the jinn and mankind for the singular purpose of worshiping Him.

learnings.question: Which Arabic term, meaning a steward or successive authority on Earth, describes humanity's caretaking role in Islamic theology?
learnings.learning: In Islamic theology, 'khalifah' refers to humanity's role as stewards or caretakers of the Earth, a responsibility that includes preserving faith and unity.

learnings.question: Which Quranic verse teaches that whoever does even 'an atom's weight' of good or evil will see the consequence of it?
learnings.learning: Surah Az-Zalzalah (99:7-8) teaches that whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it, so no deed goes unaccounted.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is a very light sleep mode meant for very short idle periods, allowing a quick wake to resume full activity?
learnings.learning: In PCIe power management, the L0s state is a very light sleep mode meant for very short idle periods, allowing the link to quickly wake and resume full activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is comparable to a computer being completely shut down, offering the greatest power savings but the longest time to wake up?
learnings.learning: The PCIe L2 power state is comparable to a computer being completely shut down — it offers the greatest power savings but takes the longest time to wake up and resume activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to Allah's complete, eternal, foreordained plan and knowledge of all events, as distinct from the actual unfolding of those events in a person's life?
learnings.learning: In Islamic theology, Qadr is Allah's complete and eternal foreordained plan and knowledge of everything that will ever happen, distinct from Qada', the actual unfolding of events in one's life.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which Quranic verse teaches that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is within themselves?
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) teaches that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is within themselves.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: A word-frequency analysis of the Quran found that its 20 most frequently used words make up roughly what percentage of its total word count?
learnings.learning: A word-frequency analysis of the Quran found that its 20 most frequently used words account for only about 20.83% of the total word count, falling well short of the 80/20 Pareto principle.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What term describes the small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds and pronunciation?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are the small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds, without which reading Arabic accurately becomes more difficult.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
